description: Use this when the buyer has agreed to the total from pinflower_quote_order: it creates the order exactly like the website's checkout and returns the secure payment link on pinflower.cz. Pass the same arguments as the quote, terms_accepted=true and confirmed_total_czk = the total the buyer agreed to; if the total has changed meanwhile, nothing is created and you get the new breakdown to read back. Collect first: the bouquet(s) (bouquet_id from search; several bouquets of ONE florist with quantities in items); delivery or pickup; for delivery the street address with house number in Prague; the recipient's name and phone when someone else receives the flowers; the date and a time (one of the times pinflower_get_bouquet offers, or 'asap'); the buyer's name, e-mail and phone (+420…); an optional card message and note for the florist; and ask whether they have a promo code. Above 10 000 Kč the buyer's billing address is required. Also on offer: address_mode 'ask_recipient' when the florist should agree the address with the recipient by phone — a surprise (the recipient's name and phone are then required); time 'agree_with_recipient' when the florist should agree the time with the recipient by phone (the recipient's name and phone are then required); ask whether it is a purchase for a company (IČO). Nothing is charged here and the florist is not told until the buyer pays.

address.description: Delivery to a known address: street and house number in Prague.

address_mode.description: ask_recipient = the courier/florist agrees the address with the recipient by phone (a surprise); no address needed, delivery priced at the whole-city rate.

billing_address.description: The buyer's billing address — required by Czech tax rules when the order is over 10 000 Kč (unless buying for a company).

bouquet_id.description: One bouquet (shortcut for items with a single line).

company.description: Buying for a company — the invoice is issued to it.

confirmed_total_czk.description: total_czk from pinflower_quote_order that the buyer agreed to — a different total refuses the order.

florist_id.description: The florist — needed only when the order is a custom bouquet alone.

items.description: Several bouquets from the SAME florist, with quantities.

addons.description: Add-on keys the bouquet offers (pinflower_get_bouquet → addons).

custom_budget_czk.description: A bouquet composed by the florist to a budget (390–2400 Kč) instead of bouquet_id; put the wishes into florist_note.

marketing_opt_in.description: Only true if the buyer asked for news and offers.

order_intent.description: order_intent from pinflower_quote_order. Retrying this call (e.g. the answer got lost) keeps it — the same order comes back; a new purchase needs a new quote.

promo_code.description: The buyer's promo code, if they have one — works for guests and signed-in buyers alike; the checkout checks it.

recipient.description: Who receives the flowers, when it is someone else than the buyer — the courier calls them.

sms_opt_out.description: true = no SMS to the recipient (keeps a surprise).

terms_accepted.description: true only after the buyer agreed to the terms.

time.description: HH:MM from the offered times, or 'asap', or 'agree_with_recipient' (the florist agrees the time with the recipient by phone; delivery only).

unit.description: Apartment, floor, company at the door.

name: pinflower_create_order
title: Order bouquets (pay on pinflower.cz)
